title: Are Large Language Models Aligned with People’s Social Intuitions for Human–Robot Interactions?

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-generated Likert scale ratings for the appropriateness of robot communicative acts and behavior desirability against ratings from human participants to identify systematic overvaluation.

Evaluating whether models assign different ratings for desirability, intentionality, and surprisingness depending on whether a given behavior is executed by a human or a robot, and contrasting this with human baseline judgments.
